settings.best_for: A mesh-back synchro-tilter rated for round-the-clock use — the pick for dispatch desks, control rooms, and any seat that is never empty.
A 500 lb multi-tilter built for bigger users and full-day desks, with width-adjustable arms and a six-prong steel base for stability.
A 500 lb bariatric stacking armchair for waiting rooms, exam rooms, and guest seating, with flat armrests that assist entry and exit.

settings.feat_title: Match the capacity to the heaviest user
settings.feat_body: Weight rating is the first number that matters. A 400 lb chair covers most big-and-tall staff; 500 lb covers bariatric and the widest range of users. Buy for the heaviest person who will sit in it, not the average.

settings.feat_title: Check the occupancy rating, not just the hours
settings.feat_body: An 8-hour task chair is not a 24/7 chair. Seats worked across shifts — dispatch, security, monitoring — need a mechanism and base rated for continuous, around-the-clock occupancy, or they wear out early.

settings.feat_title: Look at the base and mechanism, not the fabric
settings.feat_body: Heavy-duty durability lives in the steel base, the gas lift, and the tilt mechanism. A six-prong steel base, a rated gas cylinder, and contract-grade casters are what carry the load — fabric is the last decision, not the first.

settings.question: What is the best heavy-duty office chair?
settings.answer: It depends on the heaviest user and the hours the seat is worked. For around-the-clock desks we point buyers to the Offices to Go Raven 400, a synchro-tilter rated for 24/7 use; for big-and-tall staff the Global Robust multi-tilter at 500 lb capacity; and for clinical waiting and exam rooms the Global Care GC Comet bariatric stacking armchair at 500 lb. Brant Business Interiors carries all three and will match the right one to your people.

settings.question: What weight capacity do I need — 400 lb or 500 lb?
settings.answer: Buy for the heaviest person who will use the chair, not the average. A 400 lb capacity covers most big-and-tall staff; a 500 lb capacity covers bariatric users and gives the widest margin. The Raven 400 is rated to 400 lb, while the Robust multi-tilter and the GC Comet are rated to 500 lb. Tell us who is sitting and we will confirm the right rating.

settings.question: What is a 24/7 or multi-shift office chair?
settings.answer: A 24/7 chair has its mechanism, gas lift, and base rated for continuous occupancy rather than a single 8-hour shift — so it holds up where a seat is never empty, like emergency dispatch, security desks, and control rooms. The Offices to Go Raven 400 we carry is rated for 24/7 use. A standard task chair used around the clock wears out far sooner.

settings.question: Do you carry bariatric chairs for clinics and waiting rooms?
settings.answer: Yes. The Global Care GC Comet is a 500 lb bariatric stacking armchair designed for patient, exam, and waiting-room use, with a compact footprint, wall-saver legs, and flat polypropylene armrests that assist entry and exit. It stacks two-high for storage. For clinical fit-outs see our healthcare page, and tell us the room and we will spec the seating.

settings.question: Are your heavy-duty chairs certified and Canadian-made?
settings.answer: The lines we carry are built to recognised contract standards — the Global Robust is tested to exceed the BIFMA X5.11 large-occupant standard, the GC Comet exceeds ANSI/BIFMA, and the Raven 400 carries GREENGUARD Gold low-emission certification. All three are made in Canada by Global Furniture Group and its Offices to Go division. Ask us to confirm the certifications on any model you are quoting.

settings.question: Can Ontario institutions buy heavy-duty chairs without a tender?
settings.answer: Eligible Ontario broader-public-sector buyers — school boards, hospitals, and municipalities — can purchase from us without an open tender under our OECM Supplier Partner agreement, held by our parent legal entity, Brant Basics. Call us and we will confirm your eligibility and quote with delivery and installation across Ontario.
